title: Doesn’t spin without great effort
text: Doesn’t spin without great effort. I really like the color of this (yellow) and that it can hold so many of my lotions. However it barely spins at all. If I want it to fully spin I need to use two hands and push down to prevent the whole thing from moving. If I had wanted just a container I would’ve just gotten a container and spent less. I’m really disappointed that this doesn’t spin.
